    11  public import Mathlib.SetTheory.Cardinal.Arithmetic
    12  public import Mathlib.SetTheory.Cardinal.Cofinality.Ordinal

    14  /-!
    15  # The cocardinal filter
    16  
    17  In this file we define `Filter.cocardinal hc`: the filter of sets with cardinality less than
    18    a regular cardinal `c` that satisfies `Cardinal.aleph0 < c`.
    19    Such filters are `CardinalInterFilter` with cardinality `c`.
    20  
    21  -/
    22  
    23  @[expose] public section
    24  
    25  open Set Filter Cardinal
    26  
    27  universe u
    28  variable {α : Type u} {c : Cardinal.{u}} {hreg : c.IsRegular}
    29  
    30  namespace Filter
    31  
    32  variable (α) in
    33  /-- The filter defined by all sets that have a complement with at most cardinality `c`. For a union
    34  of `c` sets of `c` elements to have `c` elements, we need that `c` is a regular cardinal. -/
    35  def cocardinal (hreg : c.IsRegular) : Filter α := by
    36    apply ofCardinalUnion {s | Cardinal.mk s < c} (natCast_lt_aleph0.trans_le hreg.aleph0_le)
    37    · refine fun s hS hSc ↦ lt_of_le_of_lt (mk_sUnion_le _) <| mul_lt_of_lt hreg.aleph0_le hS ?_
    38      apply iSup_lt_of_lt_cof_ord _ fun i ↦ hSc i.1 i.2
    39      rwa [hreg.cof_ord]
    40    · exact fun _ hSc _ ht ↦ lt_of_le_of_lt (mk_le_mk_of_subset ht) hSc
    41  
    42  @[simp]
    43  theorem mem_cocardinal {s : Set α} :
    44      s ∈ cocardinal α hreg ↔ Cardinal.mk (sᶜ : Set α) < c := Iff.rfl
    45  
    46  @[simp] lemma cocardinal_aleph0_eq_cofinite :
    47      cocardinal (α := α) isRegular_aleph0 = cofinite := by
    48    aesop
    49  
    50  instance instCardinalInterFilter_cocardinal : CardinalInterFilter (cocardinal (α := α) hreg) c where
    51    cardinal_sInter_mem S hS hSs := by
    52      grw [mem_cocardinal, Set.compl_sInter, mk_sUnion_le]
    53      apply mul_lt_of_lt hreg.aleph0_le (mk_image_le.trans_lt hS) (iSup_lt_of_lt_cof_ord ..)
    54      · rw [hreg.cof_ord]
    55        exact mk_image_le.trans_lt hS
    56      · aesop
    57  
    58  @[simp]
    59  theorem eventually_cocardinal {p : α → Prop} :
    60      (∀ᶠ x in cocardinal α hreg, p x) ↔ #{ x | ¬p x } < c := Iff.rfl
